data.title: Tanks, Military Vehicles and Field Camp
data.summary: Original armoured vehicles, towed artillery, camp structures, field fortifications and supplies.
data.description: Armoured column and field camp in the armour realistic family. Twelve original vehicle designs from a main battle tank with a turret pivot to a recovery vehicle with a crane boom; eight towed and emplaced weapons; eighteen camp structures including tents, a guard tower, a gate with a lifting barrier and modular basket and sandbag walls on a 3.0 m bay; fourteen fortification and route pieces including modular trench sections on a 4.0 m bay; and twenty supply and equipment props. All designs are original with generic markings only — no national insignia, service markings or real model names, and every sign, map and display is blank. Two composed demonstrations. Static CC0 geometry prepared for human review; no rigs or animation.
